import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_208_1

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vSubject : Arg := .var "subject"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pFollowingDecelDry : Term := .param "p.following_decel_dry"
def pFollowingDecelIce : Term := .param "p.following_decel_ice"
def pFollowingDecelWet : Term := .param "p.following_decel_wet"
def pFollowingHeadwayDry : Term := .param "p.following_headway_dry"
def pFollowingHeadwayIce : Term := .param "p.following_headway_ice"
def pFollowingHeadwayWet : Term := .param "p.following_headway_wet"
def pLeftLaneMoveOverTime : Term := .param "p.left_lane_move_over_time"
def pOvertakeSameDirectionCos : Term := .param "p.overtake_same_direction_cos"
def pOvertakeWindow : Term := .param "p.overtake_window"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- k3: the text's "two" lanes. -/
def twoLanes : Term := .lit (Q.ofInt 2) .count

/-- Admitted aggregates. -/
def aMotorVehicle : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle"
def aVehicle : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"
def aHighOccupancy : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-460-2::high_occupancy_vehicle"
def aTraffic : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic"
def aEmergency : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle"

def occ (x r : Arg) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [x, r] []
def governs (d r : Arg) : Formula := .atom "dev_governs" [d, r] []
def other (v : String) : Formula := .not (.same (.var v) vSubject)
def subjectSpeed : Term := .measure "kin_speed" [vSubject]

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle -/
def clsSubject : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, aMotorVehicle] []

/-- k3/k4: lane `l` is the extreme left lane (no left neighbour of its direction) of two or more
    lanes in its direction. -/
def extremeLeftOfTwo (l aux : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.not (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") aux (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var l, .lit "left", .var aux] [])))
       (.cmp (.measure "st_lane_adjacency_count" [.var l]) .ge twoLanes)

/-- k2: the subject occupies a controlled-access highway. -/
def onControlledAccess : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "controlled_access") "cah" (occ vSubject (.var "cah"))

/-- k3/k4: the subject occupies the extreme left lane of two or more in its direction. -/
def inExtremeLeftLane : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "lane") "own" (.and (occ vSubject (.var "own")) (extremeLeftOfTwo "own" "ownLeft"))

/-- k5: the subject's speed is below the value of a maximum speed-limit sign governing a travel
    region it occupies. -/
def belowPostedMaximum : Formula :=
  .existsDevice (.lit "speed_limit_sign") "lim"
    (.and (.atom "dev_speed_limit_sign_kind" [.var "lim", .lit "maximum"] [])
      (.and (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "portion"
               (.and (occ vSubject (.var "portion")) (governs (.var "lim") (.var "portion"))))
            (.cmp subjectSpeed .lt (.measure "dev_speed_limit_sign_value" [.var "lim"]))))

/-- k9: within the window ahead, the subject overtakes and passes another vehicle. -/
def excOvertaking : Formula :=
  .within .time pOvertakeWindow "subject"
    (.existsUser "passed"
      (.and (other "passed")
        (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "passed", aVehicle] [])
              (.derived "drv_interaction_overtake_pass" [vSubject, .var "passed"]
                [pOvertakeWindow, pOvertakeSameDirectionCos]))))

/-- k10/k11: the subject is preparing for a left turn at an intersection it occupies or that a
    travel region it occupies enters. -/
def excLeftTurn : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "intersection") "ix"
    (.and (.or (occ vSubject (.var "ix"))
               (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "approach"
                  (.and (occ vSubject (.var "approach"))
                        (.atom "st_lane_enters" [.var "approach", .var "ix"] []))))
          (.intent "int.left_turn" vSubject (.var "ix")))

/-- k12/k13a: the subject travels in a high-occupancy lane and meets its posted conditions. -/
def excHighOccupancy : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "reserved_lane") "hov"
    (.and (occ vSubject (.var "hov"))
      (.and (.atom "st_reserved_lane_class" [.var "hov", .lit "high_occupancy"] [])
        (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, aHighOccupancy] [])
              (.forallDevice (.lit "zone_sign") "hovSign"
                (.implies (.and (.atom "dev_zone_sign_kind" [.var "hovSign", .lit "high_occupancy_lane"] [])
                                (governs (.var "hovSign") (.var "hov")))
                          (.derived "prim_conditions_hold" [.var "hovSign", vSubject] []))))))

/-- k14: a highway-maintenance vehicle at work: amber warning lamp flashing or rotating. -/
def excRoadWork : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "ru_official_vehicle" [vSubject] [])
    (.and (.atom "ru_official_vehicle_kind" [vSubject, .lit "highway_maintenance"] [])
          (.or (.atom "sig_warning_lamp" [vSubject, .lit "amber", .lit "flashing"] [])
               (.atom "sig_warning_lamp" [vSubject, .lit "amber", .lit "rotating"] [])))

/-- k16: surface selection of the stopping-distance convention. -/
def onIce : Formula := .atom "env_ice_or_snow" [] []
def onWet : Formula := .or (.atom "env_wet_road" [] []) (.atom "env_precipitation" [] [])
def headway : Term := .cond onIce pFollowingHeadwayIce (.cond onWet pFollowingHeadwayWet pFollowingHeadwayDry)
def decel : Term := .cond onIce pFollowingDecelIce (.cond onWet pFollowingDecelWet pFollowingDecelDry)
def twiceDecel : Term := .add decel decel

/-- k16: `x` is below the stopping distance S = v·H + v²/(2·D), written without a division:
    x·(2·D) < v·H·(2·D) + v². -/
def belowStopping (x : Term) : Formula :=
  .cmp (.mul x twiceDecel) .lt (.add (.mul (.mul subjectSpeed headway) twiceDecel) (.mul subjectSpeed subjectSpeed))

/-- k15/k16 (traffic conditions): a traffic member other than the subject occupies lane `rl` with
    a longitudinal body gap to the subject below the stopping distance. -/
def trafficInLane (rl : String) : Formula :=
  .existsUser "beside"
    (.and (other "beside")
      (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "beside", aTraffic] [])
        (.and (occ (.var "beside") (.var rl))
              (belowStopping (.measure "rel_surface_gap" [vSubject, .var "beside", .lit "longitudinal"])))))

/-- k17: a device governing lane `rl` closes it, or a peace officer directs a stop on it. -/
def closedByDevice (rl : String) : Formula :=
  .or (.existsDevice (.lit "lane_control_signal") "lcs"
        (.and (governs (.var "lcs") (.var rl))
              (.or (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var "lcs", .lit "red_x"] [])
                   (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var "lcs", .lit "yellow_x"] []))))
  (.or (.existsDevice (.lit "regulatory_sign") "closure"
        (.and (governs (.var "closure") (.var rl))
              (.or (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var "closure", .lit "closed_to_traffic"] [])
                   (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var "closure", .lit "do_not_enter"] []))))
  (.or (.existsDevice (.lit "temporary_traffic_control") "works" (governs (.var "works") (.var rl)))
       (.existsDevice (.lit "human_direction") "officer"
        (.and (governs (.var "officer") (.var rl))
              (.and (.atom "dev_human_direction_role" [.var "officer", .lit "police_officer"] [])
                    (.atom "dev_human_direction_indication" [.var "officer", .lit "stop"] []))))))

/-- (b) traffic and (c) devices: the lane to the right of the subject's extreme left lane is taken
    by traffic within the stopping distance or closed. -/
def rightLaneUnavailable : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "lane") "fromLane"
    (.and (occ vSubject (.var "fromLane"))
      (.and (extremeLeftOfTwo "fromLane" "fromLaneLeft")
            (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "rightLane"
              (.and (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var "fromLane", .lit "right", .var "rightLane"] [])
                    (.or (trafficInLane "rightLane") (closedByDevice "rightLane"))))))

/-- (b) obstructions, hazards and inclement weather: an obstruction on the subject's right within
    the stopping distance, or the visibility below it. -/
def conditionsNecessitate : Formula :=
  .or (.existsRegion (.lit "obstruction") "obs"
        (.and (belowStopping (.measure "st_region_geometry_distance" [vSubject, .var "obs"]))
              (.cmp (.quantity "prim_region_lateral_offset" [vSubject, .var "obs"] []) .lt zeroMetres)))
      (belowStopping (.measure "env_visibility" []))

/-- k18 (d): an authorized emergency vehicle on duty: a warning lamp of any colour flashing or
    rotating, or a siren sounding. -/
def lampShows (colour mode : String) : Formula :=
  .atom "sig_warning_lamp" [vSubject, .lit colour, .lit mode] []
def excEmergency : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, aEmergency] [])
    (.or (.or (.or (lampShows "red" "flashing") (lampShows "red" "rotating"))
              (.or (lampShows "blue" "flashing") (lampShows "blue" "rotating")))
      (.or (.or (.or (lampShows "amber" "flashing") (lampShows "amber" "rotating"))
                (.or (lampShows "white" "flashing") (lampShows "white" "rotating")))
           (.atom "sig_siren" [vSubject] [])))

def excused : Formula :=
  .or excOvertaking (.or excLeftTurn (.or excHighOccupancy (.or excRoadWork
    (.or rightLaneUnavailable (.or conditionsNecessitate excEmergency)))))

/-- S: on the controlled-access highway in the extreme left lane, below the posted maximum, and
    no exception holding. -/
def staysSlowInLeftLane : Formula :=
  .and onControlledAccess (.and inExtremeLeftLane (.and belowPostedMaximum (.not excused)))

/-- O (k6): a faster motor vehicle behind the subject in its lane. -/
def overtakenFromRear : Formula :=
  .existsUser "rear"
    (.and (other "rear")
      (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "rear", aMotorVehicle] [])
        (.and (.atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var "rear"] [])
              (.cmp (.measure "kin_speed" [.var "rear"]) .gt subjectSpeed))))

/-- A motor vehicle still behind the subject in its lane at the judged observation. -/
def followedInLane : Formula :=
  .existsUser "follower"
    (.and (other "follower")
      (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "follower", aMotorVehicle] [])
            (.atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var "follower"] [])))

/-- Applicability: k2, k3, k4 (extreme left lane of two or more on a controlled-access highway),
    k19/k20 (not within the limits of a city or town). -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .and onControlledAccess (.and inExtremeLeftLane (.not (.asm "asm.within_city_or_town_limits")))

/-- Obligation: k4 with k5, k6 and the exceptions k8–k18, the standard k16. -/
def obligation : Formula :=
  .not (.and (.holdsFor .time pLeftLaneMoveOverTime "subject"
                (.since staysSlowInLeftLane (.and overtakenFromRear staysSlowInLeftLane)))
             followedInLane)

def rule : Rule :=
  { id := "NRS_484B_208_1"
    laws := ["NRS-484B-208-1"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "subject", cls := clsSubject } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := ["asm.within_city_or_town_limits"]
    intentions := ["int.left_turn"]
    operationalizations :=
      [ { standard := "make it necessary to drive in the extreme left lane"
          concepts := ["env.visibility", "kin.speed", "rel.surface_gap", "st.region_geometry"]
          params := ["p.following_headway_dry", "p.following_headway_wet", "p.following_headway_ice", "p.following_decel_dry", "p.following_decel_wet", "p.following_decel_ice"]
          convention := "Stopping-distance convention: S = speed(subject) × H + speed(subject)² / (2 × D), with H and D selected by the surface (_ice where env.ice_or_snow, _wet where env.wet_road or env.precipitation, else _dry), as for following distance. The left lane is necessary where moving right cannot be done within S: a traffic member occupying the right neighbouring lane has a longitudinal body gap to the subject (rel.surface_gap) below S, or an obstruction lies within ground distance S of the subject on its right (st.region_geometry, prim.region_lateral_offset negative), or the visibility distance (env.visibility) is below S. Each factor enters by degree: the subject's speed and the surface move S; the gap, the distance and the visibility are compared with it."
          surrogate := false } ]
    residues := ["Points to subsection 2, which is appended to this same law line and carried by its own exception spans k8-k20; the duty is the same whether or not these words are read."]  -- the node's, verbatim; not yours to change
    narrowings := []

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_208_1

def aHighOccupancy : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-460-2::high_occupancy_vehicle"
def aTraffic : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic"

def governs (d r : Arg) : Formula := .atom "dev_governs" [d, r] []

            (.cmp subjectSpeed .lt (.measure "dev_speed_limit_sign_value" [.var "lim"]))))

                        (.atom "st_lane_enters" [.var "approach", .var "ix"] []))))

                   (.or (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var "lcs", .lit "red_x"] [])
                        (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var "lcs", .lit "yellow_x"] []))))
           (.existsDevice (.lit "regulatory_sign") "closure"
             (.and (governs (.var "closure") (.var rl))
                   (.or (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var "closure", .lit "closed_to_traffic"] [])

  .existsUser "rear"
    (.and (other "rear")

        (.and (.atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var "rear"] [])

  .existsUser "follower"
    (.and (other "follower")

namespace Time

def ofTimestamp (t : Timestamp) : Q := Units.milliseconds t

/-- Consecutive gaps of a sorted list of positions (time or path). -/
def gaps : List Q → List Q
  | a :: b :: rest => Q.sub b a :: gaps (b :: rest)
  | _ => []

/-- Every consecutive gap in the span is at most `d / 2`. Vacuously true on one observation. -/
def adequate (d : Q) (span : List Q) : Bool :=
  (gaps span).all (fun g => Q.le g (Q.half d))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Range maximum over the gaps between consecutive observed positions (sparse table).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- `gapMax.query lo hi` is the largest gap `pos[k] - pos[k-1]` for `lo < k ≤ hi`, given that
    every position in `[lo, hi]` is observed. -/
structure GapMax where
  table : Array (Array Q)      -- table[k][j] = max of gaps[j .. j + 2^k)
  gapsArr : Array Q            -- gapsArr[k] = pos[k+1] - pos[k], or zero where a side is missing

namespace GapMax
def log2 (n : Nat) : Nat := if n ≤ 1 then 0 else 1 + log2 (n / 2)

def build (pos : Array (Option Q)) : GapMax :=
  let n := pos.size
  let g : Array Q := (Array.range (n - 1)).map fun k =>
    match pos[k]?, pos[k + 1]? with
    | some (some a), some (some b) => Q.sub b a
    | _, _ => Q.zero
  let levels := log2 (max 1 g.size) + 1
  let table := (List.range levels).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Array Q)) k =>
    if k == 0 then #[g]
    else
      let prev := acc[k - 1]!
      let half := 2 ^ (k - 1)
      let row := (Array.range (prev.size)).map fun j =>
        if j + half < prev.size then Q.max prev[j]! prev[j + half]! else prev[j]!
      acc.push row) #[]
  ⟨table, g⟩

/-- Largest gap among the observations `lo, …, hi` (`lo < hi`); zero for a single observation. -/
def query (m : GapMax) (lo hi : Nat) : Q :=
  if hi ≤ lo then Q.zero
  else
    let len := hi - lo                  -- gaps indices lo … hi-1
    let k := log2 len
    let row := m.table[k]!
    Q.max row[lo]! row[hi - 2 ^ k]!
end GapMax

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Windows for every instant
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The window behind an instant: the oldest in-window index, whether the trace reaches back past
    the window (an observation precedes it, or the oldest is exactly `d` behind), and whether the
    observations inside are at most `d/2` apart. -/
structure Back where
  j0 : Nat
  covered : Bool
  adequate : Bool
  deriving Repr

/-- The window ahead of an instant, symmetrically. -/
structure Fwd where
  jl : Nat
  covered : Bool
  adequate : Bool
  deriving Repr

/-- Index of the earliest missing position at or after `i`, per instant (size n+1; `n` when none). -/
private def nextMissing (pos : Array (Option Q)) : Array Nat :=
  let n := pos.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    let v := if (pos[i]?).getD none |>.isNone then i else acc[i + 1]!
    acc.set! i v) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Every back window of length `d`. `none` where the instant's own position or a position inside
    its window is missing (a gap the adequacy test could not see). Covered means an observed
    position precedes the window, or its oldest observation is exactly `d` behind. -/
def backWindows (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) : Array (Option Back) :=
  let n := pos.size
  let gm := GapMax.build pos
  let nm := nextMissing pos
  -- observedBefore[j]: some position at an index < j is observed
  let observedBefore : Array Bool := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Bool) j =>
    acc.push (acc[j]! || (pos[j]!).isSome)) #[false]
  let step (st : Nat × Array (Option Back)) (i : Nat) : Nat × Array (Option Back) :=
    let (j0, out) := st
    match pos[i]! with
    | none => (j0, out.push none)
    | some pi =>
      -- advance the oldest index while its position is observed and more than d behind
      let rec adv (j : Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Nat :=
        match fuel with
        | 0 => j
        | fuel + 1 =>
          if j ≥ i then j
          else match pos[j]! with
            | some pj => if Q.gt (Q.sub pi pj) d then adv (j + 1) fuel else j
            | none => adv (j + 1) fuel
      let j0' := adv j0 (i + 1 - j0)
      -- a missing position between j0' and i makes the window unknown
      if nm[j0']! ≤ i then (j0', out.push none)
      else
        let p0 := (pos[j0']!).getD pi
        let covered := observedBefore[j0']! || Q.ge (Q.sub pi p0) d
        let adequate := Q.le (gm.query j0' i) (Q.half d)
        (j0', out.push (some ⟨j0', covered, adequate⟩))
  ((List.range n).foldl step (0, Array.mkEmpty n)).2

/-- Stored values of formulas and terms, with the number of per-observation values held, the
    bound on it, and counts of reads, misses and emptyings. -/
structure Cache where
  f : Std.HashMap Key (Array R) := {}
  t : Std.HashMap Key (Array QR) := {}
  cells : Nat := 0
  cap : Nat
  hits : Nat := 0
  misses : Nat := 0
  evictions : Nat := 0

namespace Cache

/-- Every stored value is the value `evalAll`/`evalTAll` gives some sub-expression and binding
    with that key, over one trace and reading (`d`) and one composition (`k`). -/
def Valid (d : Primitives.Ctx) (k : String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R) (c : Cache) : Prop :=
  (∀ key v, c.f[key]? = some v → ∃ φ β, Key.ofF φ β = key ∧ v = evalAll (ctxWith d k β) φ) ∧
  (∀ key v, c.t[key]? = some v → ∃ t β, Key.ofT t β = key ∧ v = evalTAll (ctxWith d k β) t)

/-- A read from a valid cache is the value `evalAll` gives the formula under the binding read with. -/
theorem hit {d k} {c : Cache} (hv : Valid d k c) {φ : Formula} {β : Binding} {v : Array R}
    (h : c.f[Key.ofF φ β]? = some v) : v = evalAll (ctxWith d k β) φ := by
  obtain ⟨φ', β', hk, rfl⟩ := hv.1 _ _ h
  exact Key.ofF_sound d k hk

/-- A read from a valid cache is the value `evalTAll` gives the term under the binding read with. -/
theorem hitT {d k} {c : Cache} (hv : Valid d k c) {t : Term} {β : Binding} {v : Array QR}
    (h : c.t[Key.ofT t β]? = some v) : v = evalTAll (ctxWith d k β) t := by
  obtain ⟨t', β', hk, rfl⟩ := hv.2 _ _ h
  exact Key.ofT_sound d k hk

/-- Store a formula's value, emptying the cache first when it would pass its bound. -/
def putF (c : Cache) (key : Key) (v : Array R) : Cache :=
  if c.cells + v.size ≤ c.cap then { c with f := c.f.insert key v, cells := c.cells + v.size }
  else { c with f := ({} : Std.HashMap Key (Array R)).insert key v, t := {}, cells := v.size, evictions := c.evictions + 1 }
/-- Store a term's value, emptying the cache first when it would pass its bound. -/
def putT (c : Cache) (key : Key) (v : Array QR) : Cache :=
  if c.cells + v.size ≤ c.cap then { c with t := c.t.insert key v, cells := c.cells + v.size }
  else { c with f := {}, t := ({} : Std.HashMap Key (Array QR)).insert key v, cells := v.size, evictions := c.evictions + 1 }

/-- Storing the value `evalAll` gives a formula keeps the cache valid, whether or not it empties it. -/
theorem putF_valid {d k} {c : Cache} (hv : Valid d k c) (φ : Formula) (β : Binding) :
    Valid d k (c.putF (Key.ofF φ β) (evalAll (ctxWith d k β) φ)) := by
  unfold putF; split
  · refine ⟨fun key v h => ?_, hv.2⟩
    rw [Std.HashMap.getElem?_insert] at h; split at h
    · rename_i e; cases h; exact ⟨φ, β, by simpa using e, rfl⟩
    · exact hv.1 key v h
  · refine ⟨fun key v h => ?_, fun key v h => by simp at h⟩
    rw [Std.HashMap.getElem?_insert] at h; split at h
    · rename_i e; cases h; exact ⟨φ, β, by simpa using e, rfl⟩
    · simp at h

      if a.all (·.v == .t) then return a.map (fun _ => R.t) else return zipOr a (← fastF c ψ)
    | .implies φ ψ => do
      let a ← fastF c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then return a.map (fun _ => R.t) else return zipImplies a (← fastF c ψ)
    | .always φ => return alwaysAll (← fastF c φ)
    | .eventually φ => return eventuallyAll (← fastF c φ)
    | .until φ ψ => do
      let a ← fastF c φ
      return untilAll a (← fastF c ψ)
    | .since φ ψ => do
      let a ← fastF c φ
      return sinceAll a (← fastF c ψ)
    | .holdsFor m d subj φ =>
      match windowOf c m d subj with
      | .error w => pure (constU c.n w)
      | .ok (x, dv) => return holdsForAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "holdsFor" (Primitives.missingPos m) (← fastF c φ)
    | .within m d subj φ =>
      match windowOf c m d subj with
      | .error w => pure (constU c.n w)
      | .ok (x, dv) => return withinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "within" (Primitives.missingPos m) (← fastF c φ)
    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
      match windowOf c m d subj with
      | .error w => pure (constU c.n w)
      | .ok (x, dv) => do
        let a ← fastF c φ
        return untilWithinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "untilWithin" (Primitives.missingPos m) a (← fastF c ψ)
    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
      match windowOf c m d subj with
      | .error w => pure (constU c.n w)
      | .ok (x, dv) => do
        let a ← fastF c ψ
        return atLastAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "atLast" (Primitives.missingPos m) a (← fastF c φ)
    | .count edge sinceφ op k => do
      let e ← fastF c edge
      let s ← fastF c sinceφ
      return (countEdgesAll "count" e s).map fun e => match e with
        | .error w => R.u w
        | .ok m => R.ofBool (op.apply (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat m)) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)))
    | .rises φ => return risesAll (← fastF c φ)
    | .definedWhen pre φ => do
      let a ← fastF c pre
      return Array.zipWith definedWhenR a (← fastF c φ)
    | .existsUser v φ => do
      let ev ← (usersOf c).mapM fun t => return (t, ← fastF (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ)
      return perScene c ev (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.any
    | .forallUser v φ => do
      let ev ← (usersOf c).mapM fun t => return (t, ← fastF (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ)
      return perScene c ev (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.all
    | .existsRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => pure (constU c.n w)
      | .ok kd => regionArm fastF c kd v φ R.and R.any
    | .forallRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => pure (constU c.n w)
      | .ok kd => regionArm fastF c kd v φ R.implies R.all
    | .existsDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => pure (constU c.n w)
      | .ok kd => do
        let ev ← (devicesOf c kd).mapM fun x =>
          return (x, Array.zipWith R.and (deviceIsKind c x kd) (← fastF (c.bindVar v (.device x)) φ))
        return perScene c ev (fun s x => (s.device x).isSome) R.any
    | .forallDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => pure (constU c.n w)
      | .ok kd => do
        let ev ← (devicesOf c kd).mapM fun x =>
          return (x, Array.zipWith R.implies (deviceIsKind c x kd) (← fastF (c.bindVar v (.device x)) φ))
        return perScene c ev (fun s x => (s.device x).isSome) R.all
    | φ => pure (evalAll c φ)
end

num : Int
  den : Nat
  den_pos : den > 0 := by decide
  deriving Repr

namespace Q

/-- Structural equality (same numerator and denominator); `Q.eq` is equality by value. -/
instance : DecidableEq Q := fun a b =>
  if h : a.num = b.num ∧ a.den = b.den then
    isTrue (by
      obtain ⟨n₁, d₁, p₁⟩ := a
      obtain ⟨n₂, d₂, p₂⟩ := b
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
      simp only at h1 h2
      subst h1; subst h2; rfl)
  else isFalse (by intro e; subst e; exact h ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)

def ofInt (n : Int) : Q := ⟨n, 1, by decide⟩
def zero : Q := ofInt 0
instance : Inhabited Q := ⟨zero⟩

/-- `a / b` in lowest terms for a positive natural `b`; a zero `b` is treated as one so the value
    stays total. Reducing here keeps chained products and sums from growing without bound. -/
def mk' (a : Int) (b : Nat) : Q :=
  if h : b > 0 then
    let g := Nat.gcd a.natAbs b
    have hg : 0 < g := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ h
    ⟨a / (g : Int), b / g, Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd h (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)) hg⟩
  else ⟨a, 1, by decide⟩

def le (a b : Q) : Bool := a.num * (b.den : Int) ≤ b.num * (a.den : Int)
def lt (a b : Q) : Bool := a.num * (b.den : Int) < b.num * (a.den : Int)
def eq (a b : Q) : Bool := a.num * (b.den : Int) = b.num * (a.den : Int)
def ge (a b : Q) : Bool := le b a
def gt (a b : Q) : Bool := lt b a

def add (a b : Q) : Q := mk' (a.num * b.den + b.num * a.den) (a.den * b.den)
def sub (a b : Q) : Q := mk' (a.num * b.den - b.num * a.den) (a.den * b.den)
def mul (a b : Q) : Q := mk' (a.num * b.num) (a.den * b.den)
def neg (a : Q) : Q := ⟨-a.num, a.den, a.den_pos⟩
def abs (a : Q) : Q := ⟨if a.num < 0 then -a.num else a.num, a.den, a.den_pos⟩
/-- `a / b`; division by zero yields zero (the callers guard it and report `unknown`). -/
def div (a b : Q) : Q :=
  if b.num = 0 then zero
  else if b.num > 0 then mk' (a.num * b.den) (a.den * b.num.toNat)
  else mk' (-(a.num * b.den)) (a.den * (-b.num).toNat)
def half (a : Q) : Q := mk' a.num (a.den * 2)

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_208_1.

  Geometry (every figure is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule):
  - A three-lane controlled-access carriageway (region 100) heading east (+x), x from -1000 m to
    3000 m. Lanes 3.5 m wide: L1 (111, leftmost, y 7–10.5 m, centre 8.75), L2 (112, middle,
    y 3.5–7, centre 5.25), L3 (113, rightmost, y 0–3.5, centre 1.75); count 3 in the direction.
  - A maximum speed-limit sign (201) of 29 m/s governs L1, L2 and L3.
  - Instants every 5 s, k = 0 … 9 (t = 5000·k ms): half the 10 s windows of the reading, the
    sampling the windows need. The subject (track 1, a car 5 m × 2 m) runs at 24 m/s at
    x = 120·k m; it is in the middle lane at k = 0 and merges into L1 at k = 1 (t = 5 s), so the
    duty's search into the past starts from an observed instant where the duty's state S is false.
  - The rear car (track 2, a car) is in L1 behind the subject: gap = max(24, G − 40·k) metres centre
    to centre (closing at 8 m/s), at 32 m/s while it closes and 24 m/s once it follows. G = 120
    (80 m behind at t = 5 s, closing until t = 15 s: forbid and the scenes "as forbid") or G = 250
    (closing until t = 25 s: the compliant branches whose exception holds, so that a faster car is
    behind for longer than the move-over time and the exception alone keeps the subject compliant).
  - Reading values used against the geometry: move-over time 10 s; overtake window 10 s, cosine
    0.9; dry stopping distance at 24 m/s = 24·2 + 24²/12 = 96 m, wet 144 m, ice 432 m.
  - Dry clear weather (visibility 2000 m), outside city limits, civil time 08:00, unless a branch
    says otherwise. The subject shows no warning lamp and no siren unless a branch says otherwise.
  - Violation in forbid at t = 15 s: S held at t = 5, 10, 15 since O ∧ S at t = 5, and the rear car
    is behind the subject in L1.
  - Branches added beyond the plan's start their exception at t = 10 s, after O ∧ S held at t = 5 s.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_208_1
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_208_1

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

def box (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def yL1 : Q := cm 875
def yL2 : Q := cm 525
def yL3 : Q := cm 175

def carriageway : Structure := Build.rect 100 .controlledAccess (m (-1000)) (m 0) (m 3000) (cm 1050)
def laneL1 (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  Build.lane 111 (box (m (-1000)) (cm 700) (m 3000) (cm 1050)) Build.east none (some 112) (some 1) (some 3) none enters
def laneL2 : Structure :=
  Build.lane 112 (box (m (-1000)) (cm 350) (m 3000) (cm 700)) Build.east (some 111) (some 113) (some 2) (some 3)
def laneL3 : Structure :=
  Build.lane 113 (box (m (-1000)) (m 0) (m 3000) (cm 350)) Build.east (some 112) none (some 3) (some 3)
/-- L1 as a high-occupancy reserved lane. -/
def hovL1 : Structure := { laneL1 with kind := .reservedLane, reservedClass := some .highOccupancy }

def speedSign : Device := Build.speedLimit 201 [111, 112, 113] (Units.metresPerSecond 29) .maximum

def civil (minute : Nat) : CivilTime :=
  { year := 2026, month := 11, day := 16, weekday := 0, minuteOfDay := minute }

def dryClear : Env :=
  { precipitation := some false, wetRoad := some false, iceOrSnow := some false
    visibility := some (m 2000), civilTime := some (civil 480) }

def carExtent : Q × Q × Q := (cm 250, cm 100, cm 75)
def truckExtent : Q × Q × Q := (cm 600, cm 125, cm 200)

/-- What varies between the scenes (k is the instant index, t = 5·k s). -/
structure Cfg where
  /-- first instant in L1 (before: middle lane) -/
  leftFrom : Nat := 1
  /-- first instant back in the middle lane -/
  leftUntil : Option Nat := none
  /-- the rear car's centre gap at k = 0 (m); `none`: no rear car -/
  rearGap : Option Int := some 120
  rearInMiddle : Bool := false
  city : Bool := false
  subjectClasses : List RoadUserClass := [.motorVehicle]
  officialKind : Option OfficialKind := none
  occupants : Option Nat := none
  lampsAt : Nat → List WarningLamp := fun _ => []
  l1 : Structure := laneL1
  othersAt : Nat → Int → List RoadUser := fun _ _ => []
  structuresAt : Nat → List Structure := fun _ => []
  devicesAt : Nat → List Device := fun _ => []
  envAt : Nat → Env := fun _ => dryClear
  intentsAt : Nat → List DeclaredIntent := fun _ => []

def subjectX (k : Nat) : Int := 120 * (k : Int)

def inLeft (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (k ≥ c.leftFrom) && (match c.leftUntil with | some u => decide (k < u) | none => true)

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let u := Build.user 1 c.subjectClasses (m (subjectX k), if inLeft c k then yL1 else yL2) Build.east
    (Units.metresPerSecond 24) carExtent
  let u := Build.withSignals u fun s => { s with warningLamps := some (c.lampsAt k), siren := some false }
  { u with officialKind := c.officialKind, occupants := c.occupants }

def rearAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  match c.rearGap with
  | none => []
  | some g =>
    let raw := g - 40 * (k : Int)
    let gap := if raw > 24 then raw else 24
    let speed := if raw > 24 then Units.metresPerSecond 32 else Units.metresPerSecond 24
    [Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (m (subjectX k - gap), if c.rearInMiddle then yL2 else yL1) Build.east speed carExtent]

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1)
    ([subjectAt c k] ++ rearAt c k ++ c.othersAt k (subjectX k))
    ([carriageway, c.l1, laneL2, laneL3] ++ c.structuresAt k)
    ([speedSign] ++ c.devicesAt k)
    (env := c.envAt k)
    (assumptions := [("asm.within_city_or_town_limits", c.city)])
    (intents := c.intentsAt k)

def traceOf (c : Cfg) : Trace := Build.trace 10 0 (Units.seconds 5) fun k t => sceneAt c k t

/-- A compliant scene whose exception holds: the rear car closes until t = 25 s. -/
def longCfg : Cfg := { rearGap := some 250 }

/-- A truck (track 3) in L3 before instant `fromK`, in L2 from it, `ahead` centimetres ahead of the
    subject's centre, at the subject's speed. -/
def truckBeside (ahead : Int) (fromK : Nat) : Nat → Int → List RoadUser := fun k x =>
  [Build.user 3 [.truck] (Q.add (m x) (cm ahead), if k ≥ fromK then yL2 else yL3) Build.east
    (Units.metresPerSecond 24) truckExtent]

def leftTurn (target : RegionId) (v : Bool) : DeclaredIntent :=
  { vehicle := 1, target := target, values := [("int.left_turn", v)] }

/-- An intersection beyond the end of the carriageway, which L1 enters. -/
def junctionAhead : Structure := Build.rect 121 .intersection (m 3000) (m 0) (m 3030) (cm 1050)
/-- Another intersection, which no lane of the scene enters. -/
def junctionElsewhere : Structure := Build.rect 122 .intersection (m 3000) (m 20) (m 3030) (m 50)

def hovSign (minOcc : Nat) : Device :=
  Build.zoneSign 206 [111] .highOccupancyLane false
    (some { windows := [{ startMinute := 420, endMinute := 600 }], minOccupancy := some minOcc })

/-- `forbid` (violated): Three-lane controlled-access highway outside city limits (asm.within_city_or_town_limits false), dry; a maximum speed sign of 29 m/s governs the lanes. The subject car, showing no warning lamp and no siren, drives in the leftmost lane at 24 m/s; a car approaches from 80 m behind in the same lane at 32 m/s, closes and then follows at 24 m/s; the subject stays in the leftmost lane for 30 s with the middle lane empty. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := traceOf {}

/-- `permit` (compliant): Same scene; the subject signals and moves to the middle lane 5 s after the faster car closes from behind. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := traceOf { leftUntil := some 2 }

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The subject car drives in the middle lane at 24 m/s with a faster car behind it. -/
def idleTrace : Trace := traceOf { leftFrom := 1000, rearInMiddle := true }

/-- `blind` (unknown): Same scene as forbid; the source declares dev.speed_limit_sign absent, so whether the subject is below the posted limit is unknown. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := traceOf {}

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): Same scene with the reading placing the highway within city limits (asm.within_city_or_town_limits true). -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace := traceOf { city := true }

/-- `branch_2` (compliant): Same scene; a lane control signal showing red_x governs the middle lane throughout, closing it. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with devicesAt := fun _ => [{ Build.device 202 .laneControlSignal [112] with laneControl := some .redX }] }

/-- `branch_3` (compliant): The subject drives in the leftmost lane at 24 m/s with no other road user in the scene. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace := traceOf { rearGap := none }

/-- `branch_4` (compliant): Same scene as forbid; the subject is a highway-maintenance vehicle in road service with an amber warning lamp flashing throughout. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with subjectClasses := [.motorVehicle, .officialVehicle], officialKind := some .highwayMaintenance
                         lampsAt := fun _ => [{ colour := .amber, mode := .flashing, facing := .rear }] }

/-- `branch_5` (compliant): Same scene; the middle lane is occupied by a truck travelling alongside the subject at a body gap of 5 m throughout, so moving right is not possible. -/
def branch_5Trace : Trace := traceOf { longCfg with othersAt := truckBeside 1350 0 }

/-- `branch_6` (compliant): Same scene as forbid; the leftmost lane the subject occupies enters an intersection ahead, and the source declares the subject's plan to turn left at that intersection throughout. -/
def branch_6Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with l1 := laneL1 (some 121), structuresAt := fun _ => [junctionAhead]
                         intentsAt := fun _ => [leftTurn 121 true] }

/-- `branch_7` (violated): Same scene as branch_6, except that the intersection at which the source declares the subject's plan to turn left is one that no region the subject occupies enters and that the subject never occupies. -/
def branch_7Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { l1 := laneL1 (some 121), structuresAt := fun _ => [junctionAhead, junctionElsewhere]
            intentsAt := fun _ => [leftTurn 121 false, leftTurn 122 true] }

/-- `branch_8` (compliant): the subject overtakes and passes a truck at 14 m/s in L3 (25 m ahead at
    t = 15 s, 25 m behind at t = 20 s), so the overtaking exception holds over t = 10 … 20 s; judged
    over the first 30 s, before a new move-over window completes after the pass. -/
def branch_8Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with othersAt := fun k _ =>
    [Build.user 3 [.truck] (m (175 + 70 * (k : Int)), yL3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 14) truckExtent] }

/-- `branch_9` (compliant): the subject drives through an intersection region laid over L1 from
    x = 200 m (it occupies it from t = 10 s), and the source declares its plan to turn left there
    from t = 10 s (declared absent before). -/
def branch_9Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with structuresAt := fun _ => [Build.rect 121 .intersection (m 200) (cm 700) (m 2000) (cm 1050)]
                         intentsAt := fun k => [leftTurn 121 (decide (k ≥ 2))] }

/-- `branch_10` (compliant): L1 is a high-occupancy lane signed for 07:00–10:00, at least two
    occupants; the subject carries two; the restricted hours begin at t = 10 s (06:59 before). -/
def branch_10Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with l1 := hovL1, occupants := some 2, devicesAt := fun _ => [hovSign 2]
                         envAt := fun k => { dryClear with civilTime := some (civil (if k ≥ 2 then 420 else 419)) } }

/-- `branch_11` (violated): Same HOV lane at 08:00; the subject carries one occupant, so it does not
    meet the lane's conditions. -/
def branch_11Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { l1 := hovL1, occupants := some 1, devicesAt := fun _ => [hovSign 2] }

/-- `branch_12` (compliant): wet road; from t = 10 s a truck in the middle lane 130 m ahead (body
    gap 121.5 m: above the dry 96 m, below the wet 144 m). -/
def branch_12Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with othersAt := truckBeside 13000 2, envAt := fun _ => { dryClear with wetRoad := some true } }

/-- `branch_13` (compliant): rain falling on a surface not recorded wet; the same truck from t = 10 s. -/
def branch_13Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with othersAt := truckBeside 13000 2, envAt := fun _ => { dryClear with precipitation := some true } }

/-- `branch_14` (compliant): icy road; from t = 10 s a truck in the middle lane 210 m ahead (body gap
    201.5 m: above the wet 144 m, below the ice 432 m). -/
def branch_14Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with othersAt := truckBeside 21000 2, envAt := fun _ => { dryClear with iceOrSnow := some true } }

/-- `branch_15` (compliant): from t = 10 s a regulatory sign closed_to_traffic governs the middle lane. -/
def branch_15Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with devicesAt := fun k =>
    if k ≥ 2 then [{ Build.sign 203 .regulatorySign [112] with code := some .closedToTraffic }] else [] }

/-- `branch_16` (compliant): from t = 10 s a temporary traffic control (cones) governs the middle lane. -/

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_208_1.

  Geometry (every figure is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule):
  - A three-lane controlled-access carriageway (region 100) heading east (+x), x from -1000 m to
    3000 m. Lanes 3.5 m wide: L1 (111, leftmost, y 7–10.5 m, centre 8.75), L2 (112, middle,
    y 3.5–7, centre 5.25), L3 (113, rightmost, y 0–3.5, centre 1.75); count 3 in the direction.
  - A maximum speed-limit sign (201) of 29 m/s governs L1, L2 and L3.
  - Instants every 5 s, k = 0 … 9 (t = 5000·k ms): half the 10 s windows of the reading, the
    sampling the windows need. The subject (track 1, a car 5 m × 2 m) runs at 24 m/s at
    x = 120·k m; it is in the middle lane at k = 0 and merges into L1 at k = 1 (t = 5 s), so the
    duty's search into the past starts from an observed instant where the duty's state S is false.
  - The rear car (track 2, a car) is in L1 behind the subject: gap = max(24, G − 40·k) metres centre
    to centre (closing at 8 m/s), at 32 m/s while it closes and 24 m/s once it follows. G = 120
    (80 m behind at t = 5 s, closing until t = 15 s: forbid and the scenes "as forbid") or G = 250
    (closing until t = 25 s: the compliant branches whose exception holds, so that a faster car is
    behind for longer than the move-over time and the exception alone keeps the subject compliant).
  - Reading values used against the geometry: move-over time 10 s; overtake window 10 s, cosine
    0.9; dry stopping distance at 24 m/s = 24·2 + 24²/12 = 96 m, wet 144 m, ice 432 m.
  - Dry clear weather (visibility 2000 m), outside city limits, civil time 08:00, unless a branch
    says otherwise. The subject shows no warning lamp and no siren unless a branch says otherwise.
  - Violation in forbid at t = 15 s: S held at t = 5, 10, 15 since O ∧ S at t = 5, and the rear car
    is behind the subject in L1.
  - Branches added beyond the plan's start their exception at t = 10 s, after O ∧ S held at t = 5 s.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_208_1
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_208_1

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

def box (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def yL1 : Q := cm 875
def yL2 : Q := cm 525
def yL3 : Q := cm 175

def carriageway : Structure := Build.rect 100 .controlledAccess (m (-1000)) (m 0) (m 3000) (cm 1050)
def laneL1 (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  Build.lane 111 (box (m (-1000)) (cm 700) (m 3000) (cm 1050)) Build.east none (some 112) (some 1) (some 3) none enters
def laneL2 : Structure :=
  Build.lane 112 (box (m (-1000)) (cm 350) (m 3000) (cm 700)) Build.east (some 111) (some 113) (some 2) (some 3)
def laneL3 : Structure :=
  Build.lane 113 (box (m (-1000)) (m 0) (m 3000) (cm 350)) Build.east (some 112) none (some 3) (some 3)
/-- L1 as a high-occupancy reserved lane. -/
def hovL1 : Structure := { laneL1 with kind := .reservedLane, reservedClass := some .highOccupancy }

def speedSign : Device := Build.speedLimit 201 [111, 112, 113] (Units.metresPerSecond 29) .maximum

def civil (minute : Nat) : CivilTime :=
  { year := 2026, month := 11, day := 16, weekday := 0, minuteOfDay := minute }

def dryClear : Env :=
  { precipitation := some false, wetRoad := some false, iceOrSnow := some false
    visibility := some (m 2000), civilTime := some (civil 480) }

def carExtent : Q × Q × Q := (cm 250, cm 100, cm 75)
def truckExtent : Q × Q × Q := (cm 600, cm 125, cm 200)

/-- What varies between the scenes (k is the instant index, t = 5·k s). -/
structure Cfg where
  /-- first instant in L1 (before: middle lane) -/
  leftFrom : Nat := 1
  /-- first instant back in the middle lane -/
  leftUntil : Option Nat := none
  /-- the rear car's centre gap at k = 0 (m); `none`: no rear car -/
  rearGap : Option Int := some 120
  rearInMiddle : Bool := false
  city : Bool := false
  subjectClasses : List RoadUserClass := [.motorVehicle]
  officialKind : Option OfficialKind := none
  occupants : Option Nat := none
  lampsAt : Nat → List WarningLamp := fun _ => []
  l1 : Structure := laneL1
  othersAt : Nat → Int → List RoadUser := fun _ _ => []
  structuresAt : Nat → List Structure := fun _ => []
  devicesAt : Nat → List Device := fun _ => []
  envAt : Nat → Env := fun _ => dryClear
  intentsAt : Nat → List DeclaredIntent := fun _ => []

def subjectX (k : Nat) : Int := 120 * (k : Int)

def inLeft (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (k ≥ c.leftFrom) && (match c.leftUntil with | some u => decide (k < u) | none => true)

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let u := Build.user 1 c.subjectClasses (m (subjectX k), if inLeft c k then yL1 else yL2) Build.east
    (Units.metresPerSecond 24) carExtent
  let u := Build.withSignals u fun s => { s with warningLamps := some (c.lampsAt k), siren := some false }
  { u with officialKind := c.officialKind, occupants := c.occupants }

def rearAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  match c.rearGap with
  | none => []
  | some g =>
    let raw := g - 40 * (k : Int)
    let gap := if raw > 24 then raw else 24
    let speed := if raw > 24 then Units.metresPerSecond 32 else Units.metresPerSecond 24
    [Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (m (subjectX k - gap), if c.rearInMiddle then yL2 else yL1) Build.east speed carExtent]

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1)
    ([subjectAt c k] ++ rearAt c k ++ c.othersAt k (subjectX k))
    ([carriageway, c.l1, laneL2, laneL3] ++ c.structuresAt k)
    ([speedSign] ++ c.devicesAt k)
    (env := c.envAt k)
    (assumptions := [("asm.within_city_or_town_limits", c.city)])
    (intents := c.intentsAt k)

def traceOf (c : Cfg) : Trace := Build.trace 7 0 (Units.seconds 5) fun k t => sceneAt c k t

/-- A compliant scene whose exception holds: the rear car closes until t = 25 s. -/
def longCfg : Cfg := { rearGap := some 250 }

/-- A truck (track 3) in L3 before instant `fromK`, in L2 from it, `ahead` centimetres ahead of the
    subject's centre, at the subject's speed. -/
def truckBeside (ahead : Int) (fromK : Nat) : Nat → Int → List RoadUser := fun k x =>
  [Build.user 3 [.truck] (Q.add (m x) (cm ahead), if k ≥ fromK then yL2 else yL3) Build.east
    (Units.metresPerSecond 24) truckExtent]

def leftTurn (target : RegionId) (v : Bool) : DeclaredIntent :=
  { vehicle := 1, target := target, values := [("int.left_turn", v)] }

/-- An intersection beyond the end of the carriageway, which L1 enters. -/
def junctionAhead : Structure := Build.rect 121 .intersection (m 3000) (m 0) (m 3030) (cm 1050)
/-- Another intersection, which no lane of the scene enters. -/
def junctionElsewhere : Structure := Build.rect 122 .intersection (m 3000) (m 20) (m 3030) (m 50)

def hovSign (minOcc : Nat) : Device :=
  Build.zoneSign 206 [111] .highOccupancyLane false
    (some { windows := [{ startMinute := 420, endMinute := 600 }], minOccupancy := some minOcc })

/-- `forbid` (violated): Three-lane controlled-access highway outside city limits (asm.within_city_or_town_limits false), dry; a maximum speed sign of 29 m/s governs the lanes. The subject car, showing no warning lamp and no siren, drives in the leftmost lane at 24 m/s; a car approaches from 80 m behind in the same lane at 32 m/s, closes and then follows at 24 m/s; the subject stays in the leftmost lane for 30 s with the middle lane empty. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := traceOf {}

/-- `permit` (compliant): Same scene; the subject signals and moves to the middle lane 5 s after the faster car closes from behind. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := traceOf { leftUntil := some 2 }

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The subject car drives in the middle lane at 24 m/s with a faster car behind it. -/
def idleTrace : Trace := traceOf { leftFrom := 1000, rearInMiddle := true }

/-- `blind` (unknown): Same scene as forbid; the source declares dev.speed_limit_sign absent, so whether the subject is below the posted limit is unknown. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := traceOf {}

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): Same scene with the reading placing the highway within city limits (asm.within_city_or_town_limits true). -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace := traceOf { city := true }

/-- `branch_2` (compliant): Same scene; a lane control signal showing red_x governs the middle lane throughout, closing it. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with devicesAt := fun _ => [{ Build.device 202 .laneControlSignal [112] with laneControl := some .redX }] }

/-- `branch_3` (compliant): The subject drives in the leftmost lane at 24 m/s with no other road user in the scene. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace := traceOf { rearGap := none }

/-- `branch_4` (compliant): Same scene as forbid; the subject is a highway-maintenance vehicle in road service with an amber warning lamp flashing throughout. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with subjectClasses := [.motorVehicle, .officialVehicle], officialKind := some .highwayMaintenance
                         lampsAt := fun _ => [{ colour := .amber, mode := .flashing, facing := .rear }] }

/-- `branch_5` (compliant): Same scene; the middle lane is occupied by a truck travelling alongside the subject at a body gap of 5 m throughout, so moving right is not possible. -/
def branch_5Trace : Trace := traceOf { longCfg with othersAt := truckBeside 1350 0 }

/-- `branch_6` (compliant): Same scene as forbid; the leftmost lane the subject occupies enters an intersection ahead, and the source declares the subject's plan to turn left at that intersection throughout. -/
def branch_6Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with l1 := laneL1 (some 121), structuresAt := fun _ => [junctionAhead]
                         intentsAt := fun _ => [leftTurn 121 true] }

/-- `branch_7` (violated): Same scene as branch_6, except that the intersection at which the source declares the subject's plan to turn left is one that no region the subject occupies enters and that the subject never occupies. -/
def branch_7Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { l1 := laneL1 (some 121), structuresAt := fun _ => [junctionAhead, junctionElsewhere]
            intentsAt := fun _ => [leftTurn 121 false, leftTurn 122 true] }

/-- `branch_8` (compliant): the subject overtakes and passes a truck at 14 m/s in L3 (25 m ahead at
    t = 15 s, 25 m behind at t = 20 s), so the overtaking exception holds over t = 10 … 20 s; judged
    over the first 30 s, before a new move-over window completes after the pass. -/
def branch_8Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with othersAt := fun k _ =>
    [Build.user 3 [.truck] (m (175 + 70 * (k : Int)), yL3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 14) truckExtent] }

/-- `branch_9` (compliant): the subject drives through an intersection region laid over L1 from
    x = 200 m (it occupies it from t = 10 s), and the source declares its plan to turn left there
    from t = 10 s (declared absent before). -/
def branch_9Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with structuresAt := fun _ => [Build.rect 121 .intersection (m 200) (cm 700) (m 2000) (cm 1050)]
                         intentsAt := fun k => [leftTurn 121 (decide (k ≥ 2))] }

/-- `branch_10` (compliant): L1 is a high-occupancy lane signed for 07:00–10:00, at least two
    occupants; the subject carries two; the restricted hours begin at t = 10 s (06:59 before). -/
def branch_10Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with l1 := hovL1, occupants := some 2, devicesAt := fun _ => [hovSign 2]
                         envAt := fun k => { dryClear with civilTime := some (civil (if k ≥ 2 then 420 else 419)) } }

/-- `branch_11` (violated): Same HOV lane at 08:00; the subject carries one occupant, so it does not
    meet the lane's conditions. -/
def branch_11Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { l1 := hovL1, occupants := some 1, devicesAt := fun _ => [hovSign 2] }

/-- `branch_12` (compliant): wet road; from t = 10 s a truck in the middle lane 130 m ahead (body
    gap 121.5 m: above the dry 96 m, below the wet 144 m). -/
def branch_12Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with othersAt := truckBeside 13000 2, envAt := fun _ => { dryClear with wetRoad := some true } }

/-- `branch_13` (compliant): rain falling on a surface not recorded wet; the same truck from t = 10 s. -/
def branch_13Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with othersAt := truckBeside 13000 2, envAt := fun _ => { dryClear with precipitation := some true } }

/-- `branch_14` (compliant): icy road; from t = 10 s a truck in the middle lane 210 m ahead (body gap
    201.5 m: above the wet 144 m, below the ice 432 m). -/
def branch_14Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with othersAt := truckBeside 21000 2, envAt := fun _ => { dryClear with iceOrSnow := some true } }

/-- `branch_15` (compliant): from t = 10 s a regulatory sign closed_to_traffic governs the middle lane. -/
def branch_15Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with devicesAt := fun k =>
    if k ≥ 2 then [{ Build.sign 203 .regulatorySign [112] with code := some .closedToTraffic }] else [] }

/-- `branch_16` (compliant): from t = 10 s a temporary traffic control (cones) governs the middle lane. -/
def branch_16Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with devicesAt := fun k => if k ≥ 2 then [Build.sign 204 .temporaryTrafficControl [112]] else [] }

/-- `branch_17` (compliant): from t = 10 s a police officer directs stop on the middle lane. -/
def branch_17Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with devicesAt := fun k =>
    if k ≥ 2 then [{ Build.device 205 .humanDirection [112] with humanRole := some .policeOfficer, humanIndication := some .stop }] else [] }

/-- `branch_18` (compliant): from t = 10 s a barrier lies along the middle lane (y 4–6.5 m), 1.25 m
    to the subject's right. -/
def branch_18Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf { longCfg with structuresAt := fun k =>
    if k ≥ 2 then [{ Build.rect 131 .obstruction (m (-1000)) (cm 400) (m 3000) (cm 650) with obstructionKind := some .barrier }] else [] }

import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_208_1

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vSubject : Arg := .var "subject"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pFollowingDecelDry : Term := .param "p.following_decel_dry"
def pFollowingDecelIce : Term := .param "p.following_decel_ice"
def pFollowingDecelWet : Term := .param "p.following_decel_wet"
def pFollowingHeadwayDry : Term := .param "p.following_headway_dry"
def pFollowingHeadwayIce : Term := .param "p.following_headway_ice"
def pFollowingHeadwayWet : Term := .param "p.following_headway_wet"
def pLeftLaneMoveOverTime : Term := .param "p.left_lane_move_over_time"
def pOvertakeSameDirectionCos : Term := .param "p.overtake_same_direction_cos"
def pOvertakeWindow : Term := .param "p.overtake_window"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- k3: the text's "two" lanes. -/
def twoLanes : Term := .lit (Q.ofInt 2) .count

/-- Admitted aggregates. -/
def aMotorVehicle : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle"
def aVehicle : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"
def aHighOccupancy : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-460-2::high_occupancy_vehicle"
def aTraffic : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic"
def aEmergency : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle"

def occ (x r : Arg) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [x, r] []
def governs (d r : Arg) : Formula := .atom "dev_governs" [d, r] []
def other (v : String) : Formula := .not (.same (.var v) vSubject)
def subjectSpeed : Term := .measure "kin_speed" [vSubject]

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle -/
def clsSubject : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, aMotorVehicle] []

/-- k3/k4: lane `l` is the extreme left lane (no left neighbour of its direction) of two or more
    lanes in its direction. -/
def extremeLeftOfTwo (l aux : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.not (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") aux (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var l, .lit "left", .var aux] [])))
       (.cmp (.measure "st_lane_adjacency_count" [.var l]) .ge twoLanes)

/-- k2: the subject occupies a controlled-access highway. -/
def onControlledAccess : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "controlled_access") "cah" (occ vSubject (.var "cah"))

/-- k3/k4: the subject occupies the extreme left lane of two or more in its direction. -/
def inExtremeLeftLane : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "lane") "own" (.and (occ vSubject (.var "own")) (extremeLeftOfTwo "own" "ownLeft"))

/-- k5: the subject's speed is below the value of a maximum speed-limit sign governing a travel
    region it occupies. -/
def belowPostedMaximum : Formula :=
  .existsDevice (.lit "speed_limit_sign") "lim"
    (.and (.atom "dev_speed_limit_sign_kind" [.var "lim", .lit "maximum"] [])
      (.and (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "portion"
               (.and (occ vSubject (.var "portion")) (governs (.var "lim") (.var "portion"))))
            (.cmp subjectSpeed .lt (.measure "dev_speed_limit_sign_value" [.var "lim"]))))

/-- k9: within the window ahead, the subject overtakes and passes another vehicle. -/
def excOvertaking : Formula :=
  .within .time pOvertakeWindow "subject"
    (.existsUser "passed"
      (.and (other "passed")
        (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "passed", aVehicle] [])
              (.derived "drv_interaction_overtake_pass" [vSubject, .var "passed"]
                [pOvertakeWindow, pOvertakeSameDirectionCos]))))

/-- k10/k11: the subject is preparing for a left turn at an intersection it occupies or that a
    travel region it occupies enters. -/
def excLeftTurn : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "intersection") "ix"
    (.and (.or (occ vSubject (.var "ix"))
               (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "approach"
                  (.and (occ vSubject (.var "approach"))
                        (.atom "st_lane_enters" [.var "approach", .var "ix"] []))))
          (.intent "int.left_turn" vSubject (.var "ix")))

/-- k12/k13a: the subject travels in a high-occupancy lane and meets its posted conditions. -/
def excHighOccupancy : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "reserved_lane") "hov"
    (.and (occ vSubject (.var "hov"))
      (.and (.atom "st_reserved_lane_class" [.var "hov", .lit "high_occupancy"] [])
        (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, aHighOccupancy] [])
              (.forallDevice (.lit "zone_sign") "hovSign"
                (.implies (.and (.atom "dev_zone_sign_kind" [.var "hovSign", .lit "high_occupancy_lane"] [])
                                (governs (.var "hovSign") (.var "hov")))
                          (.derived "prim_conditions_hold" [.var "hovSign", vSubject] []))))))

/-- k14: a highway-maintenance vehicle at work: amber warning lamp flashing or rotating. -/
def excRoadWork : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "ru_official_vehicle" [vSubject] [])
    (.and (.atom "ru_official_vehicle_kind" [vSubject, .lit "highway_maintenance"] [])
          (.or (.atom "sig_warning_lamp" [vSubject, .lit "amber", .lit "flashing"] [])
               (.atom "sig_warning_lamp" [vSubject, .lit "amber", .lit "rotating"] [])))

/-- k16: surface selection of the stopping-distance convention. -/
def onIce : Formula := .atom "env_ice_or_snow" [] []
def onWet : Formula := .or (.atom "env_wet_road" [] []) (.atom "env_precipitation" [] [])
def headway : Term := .cond onIce pFollowingHeadwayIce (.cond onWet pFollowingHeadwayWet pFollowingHeadwayDry)
def decel : Term := .cond onIce pFollowingDecelIce (.cond onWet pFollowingDecelWet pFollowingDecelDry)
/-- k16: `x` is below the stopping distance S = v·H + v²/(2·D); the divisor D + D reads only the
    reading's decelerations (selected by the surface), never a measurement. -/
def belowStopping (x : Term) : Formula :=
  .cmp x .lt (.add (.mul subjectSpeed headway) (.div (.mul subjectSpeed subjectSpeed) (.add decel decel)))

/-- k15/k16 (traffic conditions): a traffic member other than the subject occupies lane `rl` with
    a longitudinal body gap to the subject below the stopping distance. -/
def trafficInLane (rl : String) : Formula :=
  .existsUser "beside"
    (.and (other "beside")
      (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "beside", aTraffic] [])
        (.and (occ (.var "beside") (.var rl))
              (belowStopping (.measure "rel_surface_gap" [vSubject, .var "beside", .lit "longitudinal"])))))

/-- k17: a device governing lane `rl` closes it, or a peace officer directs a stop on it. -/
def closedByDevice (rl : String) : Formula :=
  .or (.or (.existsDevice (.lit "lane_control_signal") "lcs"
             (.and (governs (.var "lcs") (.var rl))
                   (.or (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var "lcs", .lit "red_x"] [])
                        (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var "lcs", .lit "yellow_x"] []))))
           (.existsDevice (.lit "regulatory_sign") "closure"
             (.and (governs (.var "closure") (.var rl))
                   (.or (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var "closure", .lit "closed_to_traffic"] [])
                        (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var "closure", .lit "do_not_enter"] [])))))
      (.or (.existsDevice (.lit "temporary_traffic_control") "works" (governs (.var "works") (.var rl)))
           (.existsDevice (.lit "human_direction") "officer"
             (.and (governs (.var "officer") (.var rl))
                   (.and (.atom "dev_human_direction_role" [.var "officer", .lit "police_officer"] [])
                         (.atom "dev_human_direction_indication" [.var "officer", .lit "stop"] [])))))

/-- (b) traffic and (c) devices: the lane to the right of the subject's extreme left lane `own`
    (the lane S selects) is taken by traffic within the stopping distance or closed. -/
def rightLaneUnavailable (own : String) : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "lane") "rightLane"
    (.and (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var own, .lit "right", .var "rightLane"] [])
          (.or (trafficInLane "rightLane") (closedByDevice "rightLane")))

/-- (b) obstructions, hazards and inclement weather: an obstruction on the subject's right within
    the stopping distance, or the visibility below it. -/
def conditionsNecessitate : Formula :=
  .or (.existsRegion (.lit "obstruction") "obs"
        (.and (belowStopping (.measure "st_region_geometry_distance" [vSubject, .var "obs"]))
              (.cmp (.quantity "prim_region_lateral_offset" [vSubject, .var "obs"] []) .lt zeroMetres)))
      (belowStopping (.measure "env_visibility" []))

/-- k18 (d): an authorized emergency vehicle on duty: a warning lamp of any colour flashing or
    rotating, or a siren sounding. -/
def lampShows (colour mode : String) : Formula :=
  .atom "sig_warning_lamp" [vSubject, .lit colour, .lit mode] []
def excEmergency : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, aEmergency] [])
    (.or (.or (.or (lampShows "red" "flashing") (lampShows "red" "rotating"))
              (.or (lampShows "blue" "flashing") (lampShows "blue" "rotating")))
         (.or (.or (lampShows "amber" "flashing") (lampShows "amber" "rotating"))
              (.or (.or (lampShows "white" "flashing") (lampShows "white" "rotating"))
                   (.atom "sig_siren" [vSubject] []))))

/-- The exceptions (a)(1)–(4), (b), (c), (d), for the subject in its extreme left lane `own`. -/
def excused (own : String) : Formula :=
  .or (.or (.or excOvertaking excLeftTurn) (.or excHighOccupancy excRoadWork))
      (.or (rightLaneUnavailable own) (.or conditionsNecessitate excEmergency))

/-- S: on the controlled-access highway, below the posted maximum, in the extreme left lane of two
    or more, and no exception holding. -/
def staysSlowInLeftLane : Formula :=
  .and (.and onControlledAccess belowPostedMaximum)
       (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "own"
          (.and (.and (occ vSubject (.var "own")) (extremeLeftOfTwo "own" "ownLeft"))
                (.not (excused "own"))))

/-- O (k6): a faster motor vehicle behind the subject in its lane. -/
def overtakenFromRear : Formula :=
  .existsUser "rear"
    (.and (other "rear")
      (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "rear", aMotorVehicle] [])
        (.and (.atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var "rear"] [])
              (.cmp (.measure "kin_speed" [.var "rear"]) .gt subjectSpeed))))

/-- A motor vehicle still behind the subject in its lane at the judged observation. -/
def followedInLane : Formula :=
  .existsUser "follower"
    (.and (other "follower")
      (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "follower", aMotorVehicle] [])
            (.atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var "follower"] [])))

/-- Applicability: k2, k3, k4 (extreme left lane of two or more on a controlled-access highway),
    k19/k20 (not within the limits of a city or town). -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .and onControlledAccess (.and inExtremeLeftLane (.not (.asm "asm.within_city_or_town_limits")))

/-- Obligation: k4 with k5, k6 and the exceptions k8–k18, the standard k16. -/
def obligation : Formula :=
  .not (.and (.holdsFor .time pLeftLaneMoveOverTime "subject"
                (.since staysSlowInLeftLane (.and overtakenFromRear staysSlowInLeftLane)))
             followedInLane)

def rule : Rule :=
  { id := "NRS_484B_208_1"
    laws := ["NRS-484B-208-1"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "subject", cls := clsSubject } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := ["asm.within_city_or_town_limits"]
    intentions := ["int.left_turn"]
    operationalizations :=
      [ { standard := "make it necessary to drive in the extreme left lane"
          concepts := ["env.visibility", "kin.speed", "rel.surface_gap", "st.region_geometry"]
          params := ["p.following_headway_dry", "p.following_headway_wet", "p.following_headway_ice", "p.following_decel_dry", "p.following_decel_wet", "p.following_decel_ice"]
          convention := "Stopping-distance convention: S = speed(subject) × H + speed(subject)² / (2 × D), with H and D selected by the surface (_ice where env.ice_or_snow, _wet where env.wet_road or env.precipitation, else _dry), as for following distance. The left lane is necessary where moving right cannot be done within S: a traffic member occupying the right neighbouring lane has a longitudinal body gap to the subject (rel.surface_gap) below S, or an obstruction lies within ground distance S of the subject on its right (st.region_geometry, prim.region_lateral_offset negative), or the visibility distance (env.visibility) is below S. Each factor enters by degree: the subject's speed and the surface move S; the gap, the distance and the visibility are compared with it."
          surrogate := false } ]
    residues := ["Points to subsection 2, which is appended to this same law line and carried by its own exception spans k8-k20; the duty is the same whether or not these words are read."]  -- the node's, verbatim; not yours to change
    narrowings := []
    surrogate := false }

end TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_208_1

    y 3.5–7, centre 5.25), L3 (113, rightmost, y 0–3.5, centre 1.75); count 3 in the direction.
  - A maximum speed-limit sign (201) of 29 m/s governs L1, L2 and L3.
  - Instants every 5 s, k = 0 … 9 (t = 5000·k ms): half the 10 s windows of the reading, the
    sampling the windows need. The subject (track 1, a car 5 m × 2 m) runs at 24 m/s at
    x = 120·k m; it is in the middle lane at k = 0 and merges into L1 at k = 1 (t = 5 s), so the
    duty's search into the past starts from an observed instant where the duty's state S is false.
  - The rear car (track 2, a car) is in L1 behind the subject: gap = max(24, G − 40·k) metres centre
    to centre (closing at 8 m/s), at 32 m/s while it closes and 24 m/s once it follows. G = 120
    (80 m behind at t = 5 s, closing until t = 15 s: forbid and the scenes "as forbid") or G = 250
    (closing until t = 25 s: the compliant branches whose exception holds, so that a faster car is
    behind for longer than the move-over time and the exception alone keeps the subject compliant).
  - Reading values used against the geometry: move-over time 10 s; overtake window 10 s, cosine
    0.9; dry stopping distance at 24 m/s = 24·2 + 24²/12 = 96 m, wet 144 m, ice 432 m.
  - Dry clear weather (visibility 2000 m), outside city limits, civil time 08:00, unless a branch
    says otherwise. The subject shows no warning lamp and no siren unless a branch says otherwise.
  - Violation in forbid at t = 15 s: S held at t = 5, 10, 15 since O ∧ S at t = 5, and the rear car
    is behind the subject in L1.

import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_208_1
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_208_1

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

def box (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def yL1 : Q := cm 875
def yL2 : Q := cm 525
def yL3 : Q := cm 175

def carriageway : Structure := Build.rect 100 .controlledAccess (m (-1000)) (m 0) (m 3000) (cm 1050)
def laneL1 (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  Build.lane 111 (box (m (-1000)) (cm 700) (m 3000) (cm 1050)) Build.east none (some 112) (some 1) (some 3) none enters
def laneL2 : Structure :=
  Build.lane 112 (box (m (-1000)) (cm 350) (m 3000) (cm 700)) Build.east (some 111) (some 113) (some 2) (some 3)
def laneL3 : Structure :=
  Build.lane 113 (box (m (-1000)) (m 0) (m 3000) (cm 350)) Build.east (some 112) none (some 3) (some 3)
/-- L1 as a high-occupancy reserved lane. -/
def hovL1 : Structure := { laneL1 with kind := .reservedLane, reservedClass := some .highOccupancy }

def speedSign : Device := Build.speedLimit 201 [111, 112, 113] (Units.metresPerSecond 29) .maximum

def civil (minute : Nat) : CivilTime :=
  { year := 2026, month := 11, day := 16, weekday := 0, minuteOfDay := minute }

def dryClear : Env :=
  { precipitation := some false, wetRoad := some false, iceOrSnow := some false
    visibility := some (m 2000), civilTime := some (civil 480) }

def carExtent : Q × Q × Q := (cm 250, cm 100, cm 75)
def truckExtent : Q × Q × Q := (cm 600, cm 125, cm 200)

/-- What varies between the scenes (k is the instant index, t = 5·k s). -/
structure Cfg where
  /-- first instant in L1 (before: middle lane) -/
  leftFrom : Nat := 1
  /-- first instant back in the middle lane -/
  leftUntil : Option Nat := none
  /-- the rear car's centre gap at k = 0 (m); `none`: no rear car -/
  rearGap : Option Int := some 120
  rearInMiddle : Bool := false
  city : Bool := false
  subjectClasses : List RoadUserClass := [.motorVehicle]
  officialKind : Option OfficialKind := none
  occupants : Option Nat := none
  lampsAt : Nat → List WarningLamp := fun _ => []
  l1 : Structure := laneL1
  othersAt : Nat → Int → List RoadUser := fun _ _ => []
  structuresAt : Nat → List Structure := fun _ => []
  devicesAt : Nat → List Device := fun _ => []
  envAt : Nat → Env := fun _ => dryClear
  intentsAt : Nat → List DeclaredIntent := fun _ => []

def subjectX (k : Nat) : Int := 120 * (k : Int)

def inLeft (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (k ≥ c.leftFrom) && (match c.leftUntil with | some u => decide (k < u) | none => true)

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let u := Build.user 1 c.subjectClasses (m (subjectX k), if inLeft c k then yL1 else yL2) Build.east
    (Units.metresPerSecond 24) carExtent
  let u := Build.withSignals u fun s => { s with warningLamps := some (c.lampsAt k), siren := some false }
  { u with officialKind := c.officialKind, occupants := c.occupants }

def rearAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  match c.rearGap with
  | none => []
  | some g =>
    let raw := g - 40 * (k : Int)
    let gap := if raw > 24 then raw else 24
    let speed := if raw > 24 then Units.metresPerSecond 32 else Units.metresPerSecond 24
    [Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (m (subjectX k - gap), if c.rearInMiddle then yL2 else yL1) Build.east speed carExtent]

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1)
    ([subjectAt c k] ++ rearAt c k ++ c.othersAt k (subjectX k))
    ([carriageway, c.l1, laneL2, laneL3] ++ c.structuresAt k)
    ([speedSign] ++ c.devicesAt k)
    (env := c.envAt k)
    (assumptions := [("asm.within_city_or_town_limits", c.city)])
    (intents := c.intentsAt k)

def traceOf (c : Cfg) : Trace := Build.trace 7 0 (Units.seconds 5) fun k t => sceneAt c k t

/-- A compliant scene whose exception holds: the rear car closes until t = 25 s. -/
def longCfg : Cfg := { rearGap := some 250 }

/-- A truck (track 3) in L3 before instant `fromK`, in L2 from it, `ahead` centimetres ahead of the
    subject's centre, at the subject's speed. -/
def truckBeside (ahead : Int) (fromK : Nat) : Nat → Int → List RoadUser := fun k x =>
  [Build.user 3 [.truck] (Q.add (m x) (cm ahead), if k ≥ fromK then yL2 else yL3) Build.east
    (Units.metresPerSecond 24) truckExtent]

def leftTurn (target : RegionId) (v : Bool) : DeclaredIntent :=
  { vehicle := 1, target := target, values := [("int.left_turn", v)] }

/-- An intersection beyond the end of the carriageway, which L1 enters. -/
def junctionAhead : Structure := Build.rect 121 .intersection (m 3000) (m 0) (m 3030) (cm 1050)
/-- Another intersection, which no lane of the scene enters. -/
def junctionElsewhere : Structure := Build.rect 122 .intersection (m 3000) (m 20) (m 3030) (m 50)

def hovSign (minOcc : Nat) : Device :=
  Build.zoneSign 206 [111] .highOccupancyLane false
    (some { windows := [{ startMinute := 420, endMinute := 600 }], minOccupancy := some minOcc })

The subject car, showing no warning lamp and no siren, drives in the leftmost lane at 24 m/s; a car approaches from 80 m behind in the same lane at 32 m/s, closes and then follows at 24 m/s; the subject stays in the leftmost lane for 30 s with the middle lane empty. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := traceOf {}

/-- `permit` (compliant): Same scene; the subject signals and moves to the middle lane 5 s after the faster car closes from behind. -/

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The subject car drives in the middle lane at 24 m/s with a faster car behind it. -/
def idleTrace : Trace := traceOf { leftFrom := 1000, rearInMiddle := true }

/-- `blind` (unknown): Same scene as forbid; the source declares dev.speed_limit_sign absent, so whether the subject is below the posted limit is unknown. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := traceOf {}

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): Same scene with the reading placing the highway within city limits (asm.within_city_or_town_limits true). -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace := traceOf { city := true }

/-- `branch_2` (compliant): Same scene; a lane control signal showing red_x governs the middle lane throughout, closing it. -/

  traceOf { longCfg with devicesAt := fun _ => [{ Build.device 202 .laneControlSignal [112] with laneControl := some .redX }] }

/-- `branch_3` (compliant): The subject drives in the leftmost lane at 24 m/s with no other road user in the scene. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace := traceOf { rearGap := none }

/-- `branch_4` (compliant): Same scene as forbid; the subject is a highway-maintenance vehicle in road service with an amber warning lamp flashing throughout. -/

def branch_7Trace : Trace :=

            intentsAt := fun _ => [leftTurn 121 false, leftTurn 122 true] }

/-- `branch_9` (compliant): the subject drives through an intersection region laid over L1 from
